messages:
Anya: Heads up — light drizzle on 5th turned into legit rain. If you scooter, maybe switch to transit. scooter deck got a splash and sounded sad :(
Devon: Thanks! Anyone seeing reports for the 22? I'm at Embarcadero and debating whether to wait or grab a cab.
commute-bot: Next 22 bus: estimated +9m due to traffic on Market (source: transit API).
Marta: there's a blue folding umbrella by the kitchen sink in HQ — free for whoever needs it. :umbrella:
Olivia: Yay Marta, I'll take it if it's still there at 8:40. Ferry run is soggy today.
Josh: PSA — wet scooter decks = sketchy. Saw someone slip yesterday, minor bruise. Wear grips or avoid.
Anya: @Olivia can we set a quick umbrella swap table by the 4th-floor stairwell? easier than leaving stuff by sink. I'll bring a towel and a tiny shoe-cover pack.
Marta: I'll leave a sticky note on the fridge with 'umbrella swap' so people don't walk off with someone else's nice one. :pushpin:
Devon: BART just announced a 6-minute departure delay at Embarcadero FYI. Might still beat a soaked scooter.
Anya: Also — anyone stuck near Mission/16th? I can detour with a dry hoodie and spare socks in ~10 min if needed.
Marco: 16th & Valencia here, soaked shoes but otherwise ok. Appreciate the offer though!
Olivia: @Anya legend, DM'd you my spot. If you bring a towel i'll trade you a coffee later.
commute-bot: Bike locker usage: 85% capacity. 3 lockers available.
Josh: Quick hack: put important papers in a produce bag inside your pack. Kept my laptop manual dry today.
Marta: Poll idea — who will come down to the swap now? react with :thumbsup: if you're on your way, :wave: if you'll grab later.
Anya: I'll stand guard at the stairwell. Also sticking a little 'lost umbrella' note on the lobby board.
Devon: Thanks for the heads-up everyone — switching to bus now. Stay dry y'all! :umbrella: :coffee:
